images.test_scope: The original build was flashed and drive-tested; the published image differs only in two equal-length NUL-terminated TinyUSB diagnostic path strings, normalized to remove a local build path. The normalized artifact was not reflashed. The user confirmed standard DOS boot and game load, IEC address and ROM settings save, write-protect and reset operate, and Control/Monitor firmware work on the drive. Full USB disconnect/reconnect persistence was not reported. This binary accepts only IEC 8/9 and may print MAX=11 for an invalid address; a later source-only correction to MAX=9 was not rebuilt into the image.

images.role: UB3 Control stock 2-ROM V53 Apply Only candidate
images.test_scope: V0.8.0.53 Apply Only behavior was user-verified on the drive: live IEC address change worked without altering the selected DOS ROM or requiring a 1541 power cycle. The published candidate was reproducibly composed and passed offline firmware inspection. Its only post-test change was equal-length normalization of two NUL-terminated TinyUSB diagnostic path strings; that normalized artifact was not reflashed. This binary accepts only IEC 8/9 and may print MAX=11 for an invalid address; a later source-only correction to MAX=9 was not rebuilt into the image.

User-confirmed LED control during reads and full power-cycle persistence; .31 capture log and native regressions retained. Public image uses default NV and two equal-length diagnostic filename replacements (212 bytes).

windows_cli.name: 1541HUD Windows CLI
windows_cli.scope: Rebuilt from the supported source using patched rustix 1.1.6 and Rust 1.99.0 MSVC; Windows CLI regressions, public package checks, dependency audit, firmware checks and both ARM builds passed in CI run 43277779018. No hardware was programmed.
